title: Also fixed: the engine's daily grading job had been red since Nov 6 (not only ParlayAPI)
body: Separate from ParlayAPI, that same job failed on every scheduled run since Nov 6: its dataset step ran out of memory and killed the runner, so the engine's settled orders and the analysis datasets were not published for 8 days (the research runs kept reporting 'digest unchanged'). The step now streams through a database file instead of holding millions of bids in memory (same output, 162 MB instead of tens of GB). A full run on GitHub went green and published the settled orders and datasets again. Details in research/parlayapi_pinnacle_withdrawn_2026-11-14.md.
